prompt: what is canola oil made from corn
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 correctly states that canola oil is made from the seeds of the canola (rapeseed) plant, not corn, and its key explanation aligns with common knowledge. Candidate 2 gives a confused and partially incorrect framing by claiming “corn oil” is also known as “canola oil,” even though it later describes extraction from canola seeds, so it doesn’t clearly and correctly answer the question. Candidate 3 wrongly describes starting with (oil-rich) genetically modified corn and extracting canola oil from corn germ, which is incorrect. Candidate 4 is also incorrect, inventing a corn-based engineered variety and claiming canola oil is corn-derived, so it fails the prompt’s core premise.
